name: doctrine.surface
description: Verify an agent instruction surface (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/skill file excerpt) actually carries the Jev System-1 cascade doctrine: an agent reading only this text would route semantic triage to Jev before frontier LLM and fail closed.

mandates_jev_first.instructions: An agent whose only context is this excerpt would send semantic triage/routing/classification to the rig-s1gate Jev path before any frontier LLM call

teaches_fail_closed.instructions: The excerpt tells the agent what to do when the fast classifier is unavailable: defer, never guess a verdict locally

findable_at_start.instructions: This text sits in an always-loaded instruction surface (not a deep reference an agent must already know about)

rules.reason: surface does not actually change agent routing
buried pointer -- the agent will never load it
surface does not say to defer when the classifier is down

notes.bar: Pass line is above 0.9. A noul of 0.90 fails the rule `noul <= 0.90`; 0.91 or higher passes. Score and choice confidence use `confidence <= 0.90`. A score is a mean on levels 0..5, so above 0.9 of that scale is a mean above 4.50.
